nodes.summary: The CTL formula $\bot$ (falsity) is the negation $\neg\top$ of the formula $\top$ (truth).
nodes.title: Falsity in CTL

nodes.summary: Fix a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms at its states, and a CTL formula $\varphi$. Write $[\![\varphi]\!]$ for the set of states satisfying $\varphi$ and $\mathrm{Pre}_\exists(Z)$ for the set of states having some successor in a set of states $Z$. Then the set of states satisfying $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$ is the least fixed point of the monotone operator…
nodes.title: $\mathsf{EF}$ is a least fixed point

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula. In a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms at its states, a state $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$ if and only if $s$ satisfies $\varphi$ or $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EX}\,\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$, that is, some successor of $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$.
nodes.title: One-step expansion of $\mathsf{EF}$

nodes.summary: Given a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms at its states, and a CTL formula $\varphi$, this is the map sending a set of states $Z$ to the set of states that satisfy $\varphi$ or have some successor in $Z$.
nodes.title: The $\mathsf{EF}$ functional

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula. In a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms at its states, a state $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$ if and only if some state $t$ reachable from $s$ by a finite, possibly empty, sequence of transitions satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: $\mathsf{EF}$ means reachability

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula. In a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms at its states, a state $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$ if and only if there are a sequence of states $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ with $s_0 = s$ and a natural number $k$ such that the sequence is a finite run of length $k$ and $s_k$ satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: $\mathsf{EF}$ via finite runs

nodes.summary: Given a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms at its states, and a CTL formula $\varphi$, this is the monotone operator on sets of states, ordered by inclusion, sending a set $Z$ to the set of states that satisfy $\varphi$ or have some successor in $Z$.
nodes.title: The $\mathsf{EF}$ operator

nodes.summary: For a CTL formula $\varphi$, the formula $\mathsf{EF}\,\varphi$ is the existential until $\mathsf{E}[\top \mathbin{\mathsf{U}} \varphi]$ with $\top$ on the left.
nodes.title: Exists finally

nodes.summary: Fix a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms at its states, and a CTL formula $\varphi$. Write $[\![\varphi]\!]$ for the set of states satisfying $\varphi$ and $\mathrm{Pre}_\exists(Z)$ for the set of states having some successor in a set of states $Z$. Then the set of states satisfying $\mathsf{EG}\,\varphi$ is the greatest fixed point of the monotone operator…
nodes.title: $\mathsf{EG}$ is a greatest fixed point

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula. In a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms at its states, a state $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EG}\,\varphi$ if and only if $s$ satisfies $\varphi$ and $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EX}\,\mathsf{EG}\,\varphi$, that is, some successor of $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{EG}\,\varphi$.
nodes.title: One-step expansion of $\mathsf{EG}$

nodes.summary: Given a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms and a CTL formula $\varphi$, this is the operator that sends a predicate $Z$ on states to the predicate holding at a state $s$ when $s$ satisfies $\varphi$ and some successor of $s$ satisfies $Z$, that is, there are a label $a$ and a state $t$ with a transition from $s$ to $t$ labelled $a$ such that $Z$ holds at $t$.
nodes.title: The functional for $\mathrm{EG}$

nodes.summary: Given a labelled transition system, a valuation of the atoms and a CTL formula $\varphi$, this is the monotone map on predicates on states, ordered pointwise by implication, that sends a predicate $Z$ to the predicate holding at a state $s$ when $s$ satisfies $\varphi$ and some successor of $s$ satisfies $Z$.
nodes.title: The $\mathrm{EG}$ functional as a monotone operator

nodes.summary: In a serial labelled transition system, if $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ is a finite run of length $k$, then there is an infinite run $s'_0, s'_1, s'_2, \dots$ with $s'_i = s_i$ for every $i \le k$.
nodes.title: Finite runs extend to infinite runs in serial systems

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ and $\psi$ be CTL formulas and $s$ a state of a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms. Then $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{E}[\varphi \mathbin{\mathrm{U}} \psi]$ if and only if either $s$ satisfies $\psi$, or $s$ satisfies $\varphi$ and some successor of $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{E}[\varphi \mathbin{\mathrm{U}} \psi]$.
nodes.title: One-step expansion of $\mathrm{EU}$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula and $s$ a state of a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms. If $s$ has no outgoing transition, then $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{AF}\,\varphi$ if and only if $s$ satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: $\mathrm{AF}$ at a deadlocked state

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula and $s$ a state of a serial labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms. Then $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{AF}\,\varphi$ if and only if $s$ does not satisfy $\mathrm{EG}\,\neg\varphi$.
nodes.title: On serial systems $\mathrm{AF}$ is $\neg\mathrm{EG}\,\neg$

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula and $s$ a state of a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms. Then $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{AF}\,\varphi$ if and only if both of the following hold: for every infinite run $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ with $s_0 = s$ there is some $k$ such that $s_k$ satisfies $\varphi$; and for every finite run $s_0, s_1, s_2, \dots$ of length $k$ with $s_0 = s$ whose endpoint $s_k$ has no…
nodes.title: Maximal-path form of $\mathrm{AF}$

nodes.summary: `AF φ`: every maximal path reaches a state satisfying `φ`, as `A[⊤ U φ]`.
nodes.title: The CTL operator AF (inevitably)

nodes.summary: Let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula and $s$ a state of a labelled transition system with a valuation of the atoms. Then $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{AG}\,\varphi$ if and only if every state $t$ reachable from $s$ (through a finite sequence of transitions, possibly empty) satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: $\mathrm{AG}$ holds iff every reachable state satisfies the formula

nodes.summary: For a CTL formula $\varphi$, the formula $\mathrm{AG}\,\varphi$ is $\neg\,\mathrm{EF}\,\neg\varphi$. It holds at a state exactly when every state reachable from it satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: The CTL operator $\mathrm{AG}$

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a state of a labelled transition system with an atom valuation, and let $\varphi$ be a CTL formula. Then $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{AX}\,\varphi$ if and only if every state $t$ with a transition from $s$ to $t$, under any label, satisfies $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Characterization of $\mathsf{AX}$

nodes.summary: For a CTL formula $\varphi$, the formula $\mathsf{AX}\,\varphi$ ("on all next states, $\varphi$") is defined as $\neg\,\mathsf{EX}\,\neg\varphi$.
nodes.title: The CTL operator $\mathsf{AX}$

nodes.summary: Let $s$ be a state of a labelled transition system with an atom valuation, and suppose that $s$ is deadlocked: there is no transition from $s$ under any label. Then for all CTL formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$, $s$ satisfies $\mathsf{A}[\varphi\,\mathsf{U}\,\psi]$ if and only if $s$ satisfies $\psi$.
nodes.title: $\mathsf{A}(\varphi\,\mathsf{U}\,\psi)$ at a deadlocked state

nodes.summary:

eg\psi\,\mathsf{U}\,(
eg\varphi \land

eg\psi$. That is, no finite run from $s$ ends at a state satisfying $
eg\varphi \land 
eg\psi$ with…
nodes.title: Classical form of $\mathsf{A}(\varphi\,\mathsf{U}\,\psi)$ on serial systems

nodes.summary: The formulas of computation tree logic over a type $A$ of atoms are generated as follows: every atom $a \in A$ is a formula, $\top$ is a formula, and if $\varphi$ and $\psi$ are formulas then so are the negation $\neg\varphi$, the conjunction $\varphi \land \psi$, the existential next $\mathsf{EX}\,\varphi$, the existential until $\mathsf{E}[\varphi\,\mathsf{U}\,\psi]$, the existential globally…
nodes.title: CTL formulas

nodes.summary: For CTL formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$, the bi-implication $\varphi \leftrightarrow \psi$ is defined as the conjunction $(\varphi \to \psi) \land (\psi \to \varphi)$ of the two implications.
nodes.title: CTL bi-implication

nodes.summary: For CTL formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$, the implication $\varphi \to \psi$ is defined as the disjunction $\neg\varphi \lor \psi$.
nodes.title: CTL implication

nodes.summary:
For CTL formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$, the disjunction $\varphi \lor \psi$ is defined as $
eg(
eg\varphi \land 
eg\psi)$.
nodes.title: CTL disjunction

nodes.summary: For a labelled transition system and a predicate $Z$ on its states, a state $s$ satisfies $\mathrm{Pre}_\exists(Z)$ when some successor of $s$ satisfies $Z$: there are a label $a$ and a state $t$ satisfying $Z$ with a transition from $s$ to $t$ labelled $a$.
nodes.title: Existential predecessor operator

nodes.summary: Fix a labelled transition system and a valuation saying which atoms hold at which states. Satisfaction of a CTL formula at a state $s$ is defined by recursion on the formula. An atom $a$ holds at $s$ when the valuation makes $a$ true at $s$; $\top$ always holds; $\neg\varphi$ holds when $\varphi$ does not; $\varphi \land \psi$ holds when both $\varphi$ and $\psi$ hold; $\mathsf{EX}\,\varphi$ holds when there is a…
nodes.title: Satisfaction of CTL formulas

nodes.summary: A labelled transition system is serial (total) when every state $s$ has a successor: there are a label $a$ and a state $t$ with a transition from $s$ to $t$ labelled $a$.
nodes.title: Serial transition systems

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
